title: 9.3 Conditional Probability

icans: I can find a conditional probability from a sample space or a two-way table.
I can use the formula for conditional probability.
I can use conditional probability to solve real-life problems.

vocab: the probability that event B happens given that event A has ___________, written P(B | A)

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Conditional probability: P(B | A) means the probability of _______________, given that _______________ has happened.
“Given”: “Given” shrinks the _______________ to the outcomes in A.

blocks.stem: A bag holds 3 red marbles and 2 blue marbles. You choose one marble, keep it, then choose another. Given that the first marble is red, what is the probability that the second is blue?

notes: From a table: P(B | A) = (number in A and B) ÷ _______________

blocks.stem:
A survey of 100 students asked about exercise and sleep.
a.  Find P(8+ hours of sleep | exercises).
b.  Find P(exercises | 8+ hours of sleep).
At a school, 60% of the students take Spanish, and 24% take Spanish and art. What is the probability that a student who takes Spanish also takes art?
Use the exercise and sleep table. Find P(doesn’t exercise | less than 8 hours of sleep).

tickets.stem: Two dice are rolled. Given that the first die is a 6, what is the probability that the sum is 10 or more?
P(A) = 0.5 and P(A and B) = 0.2. Find P(B | A).
